verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.x.ai/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key. That confirms a downloadable, machine-readable OpenAPI spec for the xAI REST API, which the llms.txt probe and API docs also describe. missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec, evidence that the spec covers all endpoints (text, image, video, speech) and is kept in sync with releases.
